title: How to run an AI council before a big decision
seoTitle: How to run an AI council before a big decision
description: Get several AI advisers to argue your decision: independent answers, cross-examination, blind ranking and a brief with the strongest dissent kept in.
lede: One AI chat gives you one confident answer to a hard decision. This guide shows how to run an AI council instead, with advisers who answer separately, challenge each other, rank the answers blind and leave you a clear decision brief.
